data.title: Starý Orgoň on Kýčera – the last pagan chieftain
data.excerpt: Starý Orgoň, the figure who has accompanied this website ever since it was founded, comes from an old legend about the last pagan chieftain, who withdrew with his followers deep into the mountains in the heart of the Javorníky and there resisted the spread of the new faith. A painting by Azraelangelo now shows him among the authentic “runic” rocks, whose mysterious carved signs can be observed even today.

children.text: Starý Orgoň is a figure who has accompanied this website ever since it was founded. His origin lies in an old
legend about the last pagan chieftain

who withdrew with his followers deep into the hard-to-reach mountains in the heart of the Javorníky and there resisted the spread of the new faith. I was all the more pleased when I received a lovely gift from my wife – a painting of Starý Orgoň on Kýčera. Its author is Azraelangelo, whom I hereby thank for the splendid work he has done.
The setting, and especially the “runic” rocks with their mysterious carved signs, is authentic – the artist drew them after the real surviving appearance in which they can be observed even today.
